notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
Mozilla Thunderbird is a standalone mail and newsgroup client.

Security Fix(es):

* libexpat: denial of service via crafted XML input (CVE-2026-45186)

* firefox: Mitigation bypass in the Enterprise Policies component (CVE-2026-109764)

* firefox: Spoofing issue in the DOM: Web Serial component (CVE-2026-109770)

* firefox: Mitigation bypass in the File Handling component (CVE-2026-109783)
